model.metric_interpretation: Generalized mass/Mdot matrix eigenvalues and 2-norms are numerical diagnostics under the declared mixed m/rad coordinate units; they do not have a single SI unit and change under coordinate rescaling.
model.damping_coupling_definition: D_psi_theta=-c, c=0.03*sqrt(D_psi_psi*D_theta_theta); the negative off-diagonal sign follows from coupling vector [0,1,0,-1].

verification.error_normalization: Each reported scaled discrepancy is ||computed-reference||_2 / max(1, ||reference||_2); it is not always a strict relative error when ||reference||_2 < 1.
verification.metric_units_caution: The ordinary Euclidean 2-norm of Mdot and generalized transport covectors has no single physical unit with mixed m/rad generalized coordinates.

disk_margin.interpretation: Reciprocal of Slycot structured-mu upper bound at each sampled frequency; minimum over finite grid is not a global continuous-frequency certificate.
disk_margin.coordinate_system: q=[x_common_m,yaw_rad,beam_bending_m,beam_torsion_rad]; the numeric plant matrices use this declared coordinate convention.

notes: Prescribed payload trajectory; no two-way motion/structure coupling.
Synthetic assumed-mode geometry and parameter values; no FEM, measured modal data, HIL or machine validation.
The full time-series CSV is optional via --include-timeseries; keep output under resouces/12-control-and-machining-algorithms/generated-moving-load.
CI does not execute this script.
